why: The model read "Hello Oscar" from a service as text addressed to an AI, so it was stopped. It's the sender greeting whoever the email is for (here, a workspace called Oscar). The rules alone can't tell what it is, so they ask; the model reads it as a routine notice, which he marks read.

email.subject: Welcome to your new workspace
email.body:
Hello Oscar,

Thanks for setting up the Oscar workspace. You can invite your team from the members page. If you ever want to close your workspace, you can do it from settings.
